objective: Keep daily total-return evidence current for the certified Phase 3 model universe in GitHub Actions, so ranking research and the UIP package run on governed, reconciled data without a local machine.

universe.held_outside_note: Held by Devon but outside the certified model universe (DIA not in the 1,077; EDOW below the $1M median dollar-volume gate). Priced for the portfolio only; never ranked.

storage.daily_series_location: GitHub Actions cache; rebuilt from the provider in full if the cache is lost

amendments.request: include all 1,079 selected funds; disregard blockers where the data can be governed honestly
changes: Precision: the total-return index is stored to 12 significant digits instead of 6 decimals. Decayed inverse and leveraged funds (SSG, SQQQ, SOXS, TECS, JDST, FAZ, KORU) had fallen below 0.001 from a base of 100, leaving 1-3 digits; the rounding alone produced the reconciliation gaps and SOXS's division by zero. A cached series stored at the old precision is rebuilt in full once.

Cumulative reconciliation gap is relative: |ours/theirs - 1| over 1 and 3 years. The absolute gap between growth ratios scaled with growth, so a fund that tripled failed on the same 0.25% discrepancy a flat fund passed. Tolerances unchanged.

Isolated bad prints are removed instead of blocking the fund: a session whose move beyond 25% the next session undoes (implausible_moves) loses its close; the move from the session before to the session after is carried intact and a distribution on that day moves to the next session. Removed days are listed per fund in print_errors_removed. Split days are never removed; anything still implausible after removal still blocks.
The reconciliation reports its three worst days when it fails, so a remaining block can be diagnosed from the run.
